zh-CN: 仓库搜索不再遗漏超过 2000 条的常见词或 MD5 匹配项；大小异常确认后会准确提示源文件已执行的移动及恢复位置。
缩略图进度改为轻量更新；普通记录状态变化不再重建无关仓库索引。
未压缩入库和完全重复自动跳过前重新核对源目录，自定义暂存路径继续保留。
性能诊断仅留在进程内，用户资料与仓库格式无需迁移。
en-US: Warehouse search includes matches beyond 2,000 items; abnormal archive confirmation reports completed source moves and recovery details accurately.
Thumbnail progress uses lightweight updates, and metadata-only saves avoid unrelated warehouse index rebuilds.
Inventory-only commits and exact duplicate auto-skip recheck the source; custom staging remains respected.
Performance diagnostics stay in memory, with no warehouse or user data migration.
